{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "High-waisted dark grey yoga pants in a soft, stretchy jersey knit, straight leg with a relaxed fit, deep charcoal (#2F3535), cotton-spandex blend.

Sustainable beige ribbed long-sleeve top, crew neck with dropped shoulders, heather taupe (#8B8A87), organic cotton with elastane for movement.

Minimalist white leather slip-on sneakers, rounded toe with a thin sole, clean white (#FFFFFF), full-grain vegan leather.

This outfit works because the stretchy bottoms and flexible knit top allow for comfortable yoga poses while keeping you warm on an autumn morning. The neutral color palette transitions seamlessly from your active session to a casual coffee meet-up with friends without needing a change. Simple accessories like small stud earrings or a delicate necklace add a touch of polish for the second part of your day, respecting your desire for both comfort and style."}
